threads.text:
Holiday Train Show at the New York Botanical Garden: two sensory-friendly mornings

When: November 14, 2026 to January 10, 2027 in the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory, with more trains in an outdoor display, per NYBG's event page.

Cost: Prices not shown on the event page; the page says the show is included in the All-Garden Pass. Check NYBG's tickets page for current prices.

Checked on the official page October 29: New York Botanical Garden event page.

facebook.text:
Holiday Train Show at the New York Botanical Garden: two sensory-friendly mornings

When: November 14, 2026 to January 10, 2027 in the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory, with more trains in an outdoor display, per NYBG's event page. On select evenings (Nov 27–29; Dec 5, 11, 12, 18–20, 26–30; Jan 2) the Conservatory stays open until 8 p.m., last entry 7:15 p.m.

Cost: Prices not shown on the event page; the page says the show is included in the All-Garden Pass. Check NYBG's tickets page for current prices.

Booking: The event page links to NYBG's tickets page; it does not say whether advance or timed tickets are required for non-members.

Family note: Sensory-friendly mornings on Saturday, November 21, 2026 and Saturday, January 9, 2027, 9 to 11 a.m., with a ticket (the page says the All-Garden Pass is included with it): trains and waterfalls stay on, videos and music are off, with a quiet space and an alternate exit. No age guidance or stroller rules are given.

Checked on the official page October 29: New York Botanical Garden event page.
